4v2.prompt:
A candid full-length snapshot of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, standing on the stone walkway of a classical garden early in the morning. She is facing the camera: her face, the front of her body and both shoulders are toward the lens and her feet point toward it. Her back is not to the camera and her head is not turned away.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Her waist is narrow, and the contrast between that small waist and the fuller chest is part of her shape. Her lower abdomen is flat and her hips are about as wide as her shoulders. Her legs are long and straight. She is 165cm and slight. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden), visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone, unretouched skin detail.

Her black straight waist-length hair is half pinned up at the crown and half loose down her back; both eyebrows and her whole jawline are clearly visible.

She wears a pale celadon-green silk qipao, plain weave with no print, cut close through the bust, ribcage and waist and falling straight to mid-calf, with flat cloth shoes.

Behind her is a still pond with duckweed drifting on it, a whitewashed wall and a bare-branched plum tree. The flagstones are still wet from overnight rain.

Flat grey overcast morning light from the whole sky, no sun and no hard shadow edge; the pond surface beside her throws a faint cool light back up under her chin. It is a low-contrast scene — her skin sits only slightly brighter than the pale stone.

She has just stopped walking and looked up at whoever is holding the phone. Her expression is ordinary and unposed, lips closed, weight still on one foot.

She is the only person in the photograph — no one else in frame, no figure in any reflection, no portrait of a person on any wall. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Candid lifestyle photo, an ordinary phone snapshot of the kind posted to Instagram without editing, fine film grain, shot on 35mm, warm natural colour grading, slight highlight clipping, faint JPEG compression at high-contrast edges.
4v2.verdict: PASS 朝向 / FAIL 光線
4v2.note: 正向朝向敘述有效——她正面朝向鏡頭，臉清楚，旗袍合身、胸腰讀得出來。但光線完全沒照 prompt 走：我寫 flat grey overcast, no sun, no hard shadow edge，出來是強烈暖色逆光＋輪廓光，而且旗袍變成亮面緞而不是我指定的 plain matte weave。

5v2.prompt:
A candid snapshot of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, seen from head to below the knee in the covered wooden walkway around the open courtyard of an old house, mid-way through dance practice. Her shoulders are turned about fifty degrees away from the camera but her face is fully turned back to it and she is looking straight into the lens; both of her eyes and both eyebrows are visible to the camera.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Her waist is narrow, and the contrast between that small waist and the fuller chest is part of her shape. Her lower abdomen is flat and her hips are about as wide as her shoulders. Her legs are long and straight. She is 165cm and slight. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden), visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone, unretouched skin detail.

Her black hair is pulled into a tight high dancer's bun with nothing falling forward, so her forehead, eyebrows, cheekbones and jawline are all fully exposed.

She wears a fitted slate-grey long-sleeved practice top tucked into wide soft black practice trousers tied at the waist, the top close enough to the body to read her ribcage and waist, bare feet on the stone.

A water bottle and a folded towel sit on the step beside her and her practice shoes are kicked off against a pillar. The courtyard stone has just been rinsed and is still wet.

Late-morning sun drops into the open courtyard behind her and lands on the wet stone, which kicks a cool grey light back up onto her legs and jaw. She stands in the shade under the eaves, so the sunlit patch of courtyard behind her is much brighter than she is and burns out.

She has stopped mid-phrase and glanced back at the phone, still breathing hard, mouth slightly open, hair damp at the temple.

She is the only person in the photograph — no one else in frame, no figure in any reflection, no portrait of a person on any wall. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Candid lifestyle photo, an ordinary phone snapshot of the kind posted to Instagram without editing, fine film grain, shot on 35mm, warm natural colour grading, slight highlight clipping, faint JPEG compression at high-contrast edges.
5v2.note: 仍然背對鏡頭。我寫 shoulders turned about fifty degrees，出來接近 140 度全背面，只有頭轉回來。服裝也偏離：指定 fitted long-sleeved practice top，出來是露背款。

_finding.facing: 正向朝向敘述（她的臉／身體正面／腳尖朝向鏡頭）在**正面站姿**有效（#4 v2 成功），但在**要求側轉角度**的構圖仍然失效（#5 v2 仍是全背面）。推測 seedream 對「站在走廊裡的人」有很強的背影先驗，角度數值不被執行。
_finding.ai_look: **我的 AI 感修正無效，而且可能反效果。** 加上 Iris Chen 驗證過的風格尾巴（candid lifestyle photo / ordinary phone snapshot / fine film grain / shot on 35mm）之後，#4 v2 看起來比 #4 v1 更像精修大片，不是更像隨手拍。
_finding.hypothesis: 風格關鍵字被稀釋。Iris 的模板全長約 90 字，風格尾巴佔約三成；我的 prompt 是 2,300–2,500 字元，同一段尾巴只佔十分之一，且前面有大量『具名反射面／色溫分裂／遮擋物』的佈光敘述在往電影感拉。未驗證。
_finding.lighting: 低反差場景（flat overcast）的光線指定被模型忽略，改成它偏好的暖逆光。這對 SEXY_SCENE_LIBRARY §3 的五段式公式是一個負面資料點。
